REUTERS/Go Nakamura/File Photo Purchase Licensing Rights , opens new tab BEIJING, March 7 (Reuters) - Government officials from China's eastern economic powerhouse Jiangsu highlighted plans to expand artificial intelligence infrastructure and upgrade manufacturing on Saturday, after President Xi Jinping urged the province to take the lead in developing technology-driven growth . Jiangsu is China's ‌second-largest provincial economy and one of its most important manufacturing and export bases. Sign up here. The province generated about 14 trillion yuan ($2 trillion) in output in 2025, making its economy larger than countries such as Spain and central to Beijing's push to sustain growth and industrial competitiveness amid rising geopolitical and trade tensions with the West. • Jiangsu governor, Liu ⁠Xiaotao, a leader of the province's delegation to China's National People's Congress, said on Saturday the province has more than 1,500 artificial intelligence companies and ranks second nationwide in computing capacity, with 66 large AI models and 283 algorithms registered with regulators • Wu Yonghong, a transport-sector official, said Jiangsu would deepen "AI plus" transport initiatives, developing about 50 pilot applications using AI to improve infrastructure management and logistics services • Zheng Haitao, mayor of Jiangsu's Yangzhou, said AI was already being applied across local manufacturing, with 186 smart production lines ‌built ⁠in sectors including automotive components and environmental equipment • Zheng said Yangzhou was introducing incentives, including computing subsidies and AI talent programmes, to attract companies and build a local AI ecosystem • President Xi is himself a deputy to the Jiangsu delegation and regularly joins its deliberations. Speaking to Jiangsu ⁠lawmakers on Thursday, he urged the province to lead the country in developing "new quality productive forces", Beijing's term for economic growth driven by tech innovation • Xi's comments were further underscored on Thursday in ⁠China's 15th five-year plan, which mentioned AI over 50 times and included a detailed "AI plus" action plan aimed at embedding the technology across China's economy and society • China's National People's Congress ⁠is attended by around 3,000 deputies from provincial and regional delegations that include officials, executives, academics, and workers. These deputies discuss and pass legislation and policy priorities during the annual parliamentary session in Beijing Reporting by Eduardo Baptista; Editing by Tom Hogue Our Standards: The Thomson Reuters Trust Principles. , opens new tab Suggested Topics: Asia Pacific Purchase Licensing Rights
title: China's Jiangsu touts AI industrial push as Xi urges province to lead
movement_title: 江苏推动AI发展，升级制造业与基础设施
movement_abstract: 中国江苏省官员在2025年7月26日的上海世界人工智能大会上强调了扩大人工智能基础设施和升级制造业的计划。江苏作为中国第二大省级经济体和重要的制造业和出口基地，2025年经济总量达14万亿元，超过西班牙。江苏省长刘小涛表示，江苏拥有超过1500家人工智能企业，计算能力位居全国第二，拥有66个大型AI模型和283个算法。此外，江苏将深化“AI+”交通计划，推动约50个试点应用，提升基础设施管理和物流服务。扬州市市长郑浩涛表示，AI已广泛应用于当地制造业，已建成186条智能生产线，并推出激励措施吸引企业建立本地AI生态系统。习近平主席强调江苏应引领发展“新质生产力”，并在中国“十四五”规划中多次提及AI，提出详细的“AI+”行动计划。

content: (中央社華盛頓6日綜合外電報導)知情人士透露,美國調查人員認為,與中國政府有關聯的駭客已入侵聯邦調查局(FBI)內部網絡,而這個網絡存有美國國內監控指令的相關資訊。 「華爾街日報」援引知情人士說法報導,目前尚不清楚入侵的範圍與嚴重程度,調查也仍處於初期階段。隨著調查人員蒐集到更多資訊,任何初步結論都可能發生變化。 若證實中國確實為此次入侵的幕後黑手,將代表中國駭客再次滲透與執法監控指令相關的電腦系統,這些系統存有高度敏感的資料。 知情人士指出,近日發送給部分國會議員的一份通知中提到,FBI上個月已開始調查此事。 這次入侵事件涉及駭客存取一個非機密系統,該系統包含有關刑事嫌疑人及其他受政府監控人士的通話和網路活動資訊。系統中的資訊包括來電與去電、IP位址和網站位址以及一些路由資訊,但不包含通話或數位通訊的內容。 FBI透過聲明表示:「FBI已辨識出並處理了FBI網絡上的可疑活動,我們已動用所有技術能力來應對...我們沒有額外資訊可以提供。」 中國駐華盛頓大使館未立即回應置評請求。北京當局向來否認西方對中國駭客攻擊政府和商業網絡的指控,並反控美國是網路空間的侵略者。 美國有線電視新聞網(CNN)昨天報導稱,FBI正在調查內部系統的一次入侵事件。 華爾街日報曾在2024年報導,被資安研究人員稱為「鹽颱風」(Salt Typhoon)的中國駭客,在一次對美國電信供應商的大規模入侵行動中,存取了聯邦政府用於法院授權網路監聽請求的系統資訊。 目前尚不清楚「鹽颱風」這個後來被美方認定與中國情報部門有關的組織,是否為這次最新的入侵事件的幕後黑手,或是由其他行為者所為。華爾街日報稱,中國政府與大量的私人承包商合作,這些承包商負責為中國間諜機構執行各類駭客任務。 FBI持續在調查「鹽颱風」的入侵事件,現任和前任情報官員將其描述為有記錄以來最嚴重的美國情報失誤之一。 華爾街日報先前報導,這起事件讓中國間諜得以存取大量美國客戶的通話數據、至少數十名重要人士(包括總統川普)未加密的私人通話和簡訊,以及可能為未來攻擊提供資訊的敏感執法資訊和技術網路資訊。(編譯:李佩珊)1150307 本網站之文字、圖片及影音,非經授權,不得轉載、公開播送或公開傳輸及利用。
title: 傳中國駭客滲透FBI網絡 鎖定美國國內監控情資
movement_title: FBI网络遭疑似中国黑客入侵 调查仍在进行
movement_abstract: 美国联邦调查局(FBI)内部网络近期遭疑似与中国政府有关联的黑客入侵，该网络存储有关美国国内监控指令的信息。知情人士透露，目前尚不清楚入侵范围与严重程度，调查仍在初期阶段。FBI表示已识别并处理了可疑活动，但未提供更多细节。中国驻华盛顿大使馆未回应置评请求。此前报道指出，被称作‘盐台风’的中国黑客曾入侵美国电信供应商，并获取政府监控系统信息。FBI将‘盐台风’视为美国情报史上最严重的失误之一，认为其可能再次渗透执法监控系统，获取敏感数据。

content: An American anti-drone system proven to work against Russian drones in Ukraine will soon be sent to the Middle East to bolster U.S. defenses against Iranian drones, two U.S. officials told The Associated Press on Friday. While the U.S. has used Patriot and THAAD missile systems to take down Iranian missiles successfully, there are limited effective anti-drone defenses now in the Middle East, according to a U.S. defense official, one of two officials who spoke on condition of anonymity to discuss sensitive military matters. The U.S. response to countering Iran’s Shahed drones has been “disappointing,” the other U.S. official said, particularly because the drones fired by Iran are a much more basic version of the same drone that Russia is continuously refining and updating in its war in Ukraine. The effort to bolster U.S. anti-drone capabilities in the Middle East underscores concerns about the planning for an Iranian retaliatory response across the region to the American and Israeli strikes. Persian Gulf countries have complained they were not given adequate time to prepare for the torrent of Iranian drones and missiles bombarding their territory. The system that is being sent, known as Merops, flies drones against drones. It is small enough to fit in the back of a midsize pickup truck, can identify drones and close in on them, using artificial intelligence to navigate when satellite and electronic communications are jammed. Drones are hard to pinpoint on radar systems calibrated for spotting high-speed missiles and can be mistaken for birds or planes. The Merops system is designed to spot them and take them down. Crucially, the system also is cheaper than firing a missile that costs hundreds of thousands of dollars at a drone that costs less than $50,000. The top Democrat on the House Intelligence Committee, Rep. Jim Himes of Connecticut, said this week that “we’re pretty good at taking missiles down. What is much more problematic for us is the huge inventory of Iranian drones, which are hard to detect and hard to take down.” Himes said the drone attacks present a “math problem” in that the U.S. cannot keep relying on expensive military interceptors, like Patriot systems, to down the quickly and cheaply made Iranian drones. “It’s really, really expensive to take down a cheap drone,” he said. “A giant missile going after a tiny little crappy drone.” Merops was deployed in NATO nations Poland and Romania in November after Russian attack drones repeatedly entered NATO airspace. The U.S. defense official says America has learned lessons from the deployment of the system and others like it in Ukraine. Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy said Thursday that the U.S. asked for his country’s help in combating Iran’s Shahed drones, which Russia has used in huge numbers in Ukraine. Zelenskyy did not specify the type of assistance Ukraine would provide, but the U.S. defense official said the Merops system is a part of it. When asked about Zelenskyy’s comments, Trump told Reuters on Thursday: “Certainly, I’ll take, you know, any assistance from any country.” In the Middle East, Merops will be deployed to various locations, including where U.S. forces are not present, the defense official said. Most of the systems will be sent directly by Perennial Autonomy — the manufacturer backed by former Google CEO Eric Schmidt — and will not affect defenses in Europe, the official said. Perennial Autonomy did not immediately respond to questions about the use of Merops in the Middle East. Pentagon officials conceded this week in closed-door briefings with lawmakers they are struggling to stop waves of drones launched by Iran, leaving some U.S. targets in the Gulf region vulnerable. “This does not mean we can stop everything, but we ensured that the maximum possible defense and maximum possible force protection was set up before we went on offense,” Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth told reporters this week. Michael Robbins, president and CEO of AUVSI, a drone industry group, said lessons from the Middle East and Ukraine show that the U.S. must accelerate deployment of sophisticated counter-drone technologies, so “our forces can defend bases and populations without spending a million dollars to stop a $50,000 threat.” Associated Press writers Lisa Mascaro, Didi Tang, David Klepper, Michelle L. Price, Ben Finley and Seung Min Kim contributed to this report from Washington.
title: US to send anti-drone system to Mideast after successful use in Ukraine, officials say
movement_title: 美国将反无人机系统Merops部署中东应对伊朗威胁
movement_abstract: 美国官员透露，一种在美国乌克兰战场成功击落俄罗斯无人机的反无人机系统Merops即将被送往中东，以增强美国对伊朗无人机的防御能力。目前中东地区缺乏有效的反无人机系统，而伊朗的Shahed无人机成本低廉且难以拦截。Merops系统通过无人机对抗无人机，具备人工智能导航能力，成本远低于导弹拦截。美国国防部承认在应对伊朗无人机方面存在困难，担忧伊朗可能的报复行动。乌克兰总统泽连斯基表示愿意协助美国对抗伊朗无人机，而特朗普也表示愿意接受任何国家的援助。Merops将部署在中东多个地点，包括美军未驻扎区域，由Perennial Autonomy公司负责，该公司由前谷歌CEO埃里克·施密特支持。

movement_title: 特朗普政府拟制定AI合同新规要求公司允许政府合法使用模型
movement_abstract: 据《金融时报》报道，特朗普政府拟制定严格规定，要求与政府签订民用人工智能合同的公司允许其模型被任何合法用途使用。此举是由于美国国防部与Anthropic之间出现僵局。草案规定，寻求与政府合作的AI公司必须授予美国不可撤销的许可，允许其系统用于所有合法目的。目前《路透社》尚未能立即核实该报道。

content: President Trump’s urging of pregnant women to avoid taking Tylenol last year on the unfounded claim that it could be linked to autism in children resulted in a notable drop in orders for the common over-the-counter medication among pregnancy-related emergency department visits, according to an analysis published this week. The study published The Lancet medical journal looked at hospital data of emergency department visits in the months before and after Trump warned in September against taking acetaminophen while pregnant. It found that orders for acetaminophen among pregnant emergency department patients aged between 15 and 44 fell by 10 percent while no significant change in acetaminophen use was found among non-pregnant female emergency department patients in the same age range. “Taking Tylenol is not good,” Trump said from the Oval Office. “Fight like hell not to take it.” To support his claims, Trump and the health leaders in his administration cited a National Institutes of Health-funded review by Mount Sinai and Harvard researchers, which analyzed previous studies and found an “association” of acetaminophen use during pregnancy and neurodevelopmental disorders, though it did not establish a causal link. During the same briefing in which Trump warned against taking acetaminophen, Food and Drug Administration (FDA) Commissioner Marty Makary said his agency would be promoting leucovorin, a form of the B vitamin folic acid, as a way of reducing autism symptoms. A change in leucovorin uptake was also observed by the study, with outpatient leucovorin prescriptions for children between 5 and 17 years of age jumping by 71 percent in the study period. “Although causal claims cannot be made, the observed associations are consistent with influence of new FDA recommendations on clinical decisions,” the study stated. “It is unknown whether the results reported reflect changes in patient demand or clinician decision making; nonetheless, they show the apparent power that public authority figures have to drive sudden changes in health-care practices.” The authors noted that the recommendations coming from the White House were based on “low-quality evidence,” yet was still enough to increase interest despite there being “no new data.” The study published this week was authored by Jeremy Samuel Faust, assistant professor at Harvard Medical School, and Michael L. Barnett, Sorensen Family Provost’s professor of health services, policy, and practice at Brown University School of Public Health.
title: Unproven Trump autism claim affected care: Research
movement_title: 特朗普警告孕妇勿服泰诺致订单骤降
movement_abstract: 根据本周发表在《柳叶刀》医学期刊上的一项研究，特朗普去年呼吁孕妇避免服用泰诺（Tylenol），声称其可能与儿童自闭症有关，导致与妊娠相关的急诊科就诊中泰诺订单显著下降。研究分析了特朗普在9月发出警告前后急诊科的数据，发现15至44岁孕妇中泰诺订单减少了10%，而非孕妇则无明显变化。特朗普及其政府官员引用了国立卫生研究院资助的研究，指出服用泰诺与神经发育障碍存在‘关联’，但未建立因果关系。与此同时，FDA表示将推广叶酸的一种形式——亚叶酸，以减少自闭症症状，研究也发现儿童亚叶酸处方量上升了71%。研究指出，尽管证据质量较低，但特朗普的建议仍影响了医疗行为。

content: Actress Daryl Hannah sharply condemned her depiction in the John F. Kennedy Jr. and Carolyn Bessette-centered “Love Story” TV series, calling it “false” and “textbook misogyny” in a New York Times opinion piece published on Friday. “It’s appalling to me that I even have to defend myself against a television show,” Hannah wrote in her op-ed. “These are not creative embellishments of personality. They are assertions about conduct — and they are false.” The new Ryan Murphy-directed “Love Story” on FX follows Kennedy and Bessette, who married in 1996 and tragically died in a plane crash three years later. One character in the show, played by Dree Hemingway, uses Hannah’s name and presents as the actress, who dated Kennedy between 1988 and 1994. “The actions and behaviors attributed to me are untrue,” the real-life Hannah writes. “I have never used cocaine in my life or hosted cocaine-fueled parties. I have never pressured anyone into marriage. I have never desecrated any family heirloom or intruded upon anyone’s private memorial. I have never planted any story in the press. I never compared Jacqueline Onassis’ death to a dog’s.” She criticized that her portrayal in the show as “irritating, self-absorbed, whiny and inappropriate,” saying it was both inaccurate and “no accident.” Nina Jacobson, one of the producers of the series, has argued that Hannah’s character is a necessary “adversary” to the main storyline of the romance between Bessette and Kennedy. Hannah responded that she understands that “storytelling requires tension” but argued that “a real, living person is not a narrative device.” “When entertainment borrows a real person’s name, it can permanently impact her reputation,” she said. “Popular culture has long elevated certain women by portraying others as rivals, obstacles or villains,” Hannah said. “Isn’t it textbook misogyny to tear down one woman in order to build up another?” Though the show is inspired by Elizabeth Beller’s book, “Once Upon a Time: The Captivating Life of Carolyn Bessette-Kennedy,” Hannah argued many people can’t distinguish fiction from fact, making them see her portrayal as a true representation of her real character. Hannah said since the show premiered on Feb. 12, she has received a string of “hostile” and “even threatening” messages from viewers. She said she was advised by Onassis before she died that while publications often sold “ridiculous lies” about public figures, few people continued caring about them the next day. Hannah said she found “great comfort and consolation in those words” but argued that they “no longer hold true” in the digital age where social media preserves and digs up stories from the past forever. “A dramatized portrayal can become, for millions of viewers, the definitive version of a real person’s life,” she said
title: Daryl Hannah denounces her ‘appalling’ and ‘false’ depiction in JFK Jr. ‘Love Story’ series
movement_title: 达莉尔·汉娜批评电视剧歪曲其形象为性别歧视
movement_abstract: 演员达莉尔·汉娜强烈批评了以约翰·肯尼迪 Jr. 和卡罗琳·贝塞特为中心的电视剧《爱情故事》中对其形象的刻画，称其为‘虚假’和‘典型的性别歧视’。她在《纽约时报》的评论文章中表示，这些描述并非艺术创作，而是对行为的错误断言，并列举了多项与她本人经历不符的指控。该剧由瑞安·墨菲执导，讲述了贝塞特与肯尼迪的婚姻及悲剧结局。汉娜指出，剧中角色使用她的名字并将其塑造成一个负面形象，而她本人从未有过这些行为。她批评这种刻画是‘不准确且有预谋的’，并认为这反映了流行文化中对女性的刻板印象。她还提到，自该剧播出后，她收到了大量敌意甚至威胁性的信息。

content: The Pentagon has tapped Gavin Kliger, a former Department of Government Efficiency (DOGE) employee, to lead the DOD’s growing adoption of artificial intelligence capabilities as its new chief data officer. “We are in a global competition for military AI dominance, and America must build on its leadership to extend our advantage over adversaries,” Kliger said Friday in an announcement posted by the Pentagon’s research and engineering directorate, which is led by Emil Michael. Kliger was previously involved with the Trump administration’s DOGE cost-cutting efforts at the Defense Department, which were inspired by Elon Musk. According to the Pentagon, he also played a critical role in helping the department launch its enterprise AI platform known as GenAI.mil and had a hand in the ongoing Drone Dominance Program. As CDO, Kliger will continue to oversee the Pentagon’s AI adoption strategy, focusing on ensuring the execution of projects across the department and working with frontier artificial intelligence labs. Advertisement “My mission is to integrate the unparalleled innovation of America’s private sector with the Department’s operational expertise to rapidly deliver advanced AI capabilities to our warfighters,” he said in a statement. “By driving pace-setting projects with wartime urgency, we will ensure cutting-edge technology translates into decisive battlefield advantages for the United States.” A software engineer by trade, Kliger also worked as senior advisor to the director for technology and delivery at the Office of Personnel Management. Prior to joining public service in 2025, he spent five years working at Databricks. Kliger enters the role at a tumultuous time for the Defense Department and industry, as the Pentagon is currently involved in a high-stakes dispute with Anthropic over the U.S. military’s use of the company’s generative AI tools. Anthropic CEO Dario Amodai announced Feb. 26 that the firm would not acquiesce to demands that would allow the department to deploy the Claude AI for “all lawful use cases” without limitations — largely due to the company’s ethical concerns about the technology’s potential use with autonomous weapons and mass surveillance. Afterwards, the Pentagon named Anthropic and its products as a supply chain risk. Both President Donald Trump and Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth also accused the company of threatening national security. Written by Mikayla Easley Mikayla Easley reports on the Pentagon’s acquisition and use of emerging technologies. Prior to joining DefenseScoop, she covered national security and the defense industry for National Defense Magazine. She received a BA in Russian language and literature from the University of Michigan and a MA in journalism from the University of Missouri. title: Pentagon names former DOGE employee Gavin Kliger as new chief data officer
movement_title: 美国国防部任命前DOGE员工担任首席数据官领导AI应用
movement_abstract: 美国国防部已任命前政府效率部（DOGE）员工加文·克里格（Gavin Kliger）担任首席数据官（CDO），领导国防部在人工智能（AI）能力方面的扩展应用。克里格曾在特朗普政府的DOGE部门参与成本削减工作，并在国防部的GenAI.mil企业AI平台和无人机主导计划中发挥关键作用。他将负责确保国防部AI项目的执行，并与前沿AI实验室合作。克里格表示，其目标是将美国私营部门的创新与国防部的运营经验结合，为美军快速交付先进的AI能力。目前，国防部正与Anthropic公司就其生成式AI工具的使用展开高风险争执，后者因伦理担忧拒绝无限制部署其AI技术。

content: Click to expand Image The City Court in St. Petersburg, Russia on February 24, 2026, when the ruling against Coming Out was handed down. © 2026 AP Photo Last week, a St. Petersburg court in a closed door hearing, designated a leading Russian LGBT rights group, Coming Out, as an “extremist organization.” The ruling delivers another severe blow to a community that has become a key target of the Kremlin’s harmful “traditional values” crusade. Coming Out is the first LGBT rights organization to be formally designated “extremist” since Russia’s Supreme Court in 2023 prohibited the so-called International LGBT Movement, opening the floodgates for arbitrary prosecutions of LGBT individuals or those perceived to be, along with anyone who defends their rights or expresses solidarity with them. The case against Coming Out stemmed from a classified lawsuit filed by Russia’s Justice Ministry and authorities did not disclose any details of the proceedings. It represents yet another example of Russian authorities weaponizing the justice system to marginalize and censor LGBT people and their supporters, flagrantly violating their rights to free expression, association, and nondiscrimination. In a statement released on social media , the organization, which now operates from outside Russia, said it had long anticipated such an outcome in light of the 2023 ruling and that it will continue assisting LGBT people inside Russia and in exile. “This [designation] is another confirmation that our work is important and needed – otherwise, the government would not have made all these efforts to stop it,” the group said. No court ruling cancels out the reality of people needing psychological support, legal assistance, information and human empathy. Today, it is particularly important not to succumb to fear and not to stay in isolation. Our community is stronger than any [extremism or other] labels, which has been proven by history. Love is stronger than hate. We will be with you for as long as you need us.” The extremist designation puts Coming Out activists at risk of criminal prosecution facing up to ten years’ imprisonment. Those who continue to engage with the organization risk up to six years in prison. The Justice Ministry has brought similar cases against two other groups , LGBT Network and Irida, which are currently pending. Other governments and international institutional should call on the Kremlin to end its crackdown on LGBT people and their supporters. Governments should also provide safe haven and meaningful protection to those fleeing Russia for fear of prosecution.
title: Russia Declares Leading LGBT Rights Group ‘Extremist’

movement_abstract: 2026年2月24日，俄罗斯圣彼得堡市法院在闭门听证中将俄罗斯领先的LGBT权利组织‘Coming Out’认定为‘极端组织’。此举再次打击了LGBT群体，使其成为克里姆林宫‘传统价值观’运动的主要目标。自2023年俄罗斯最高法院禁止所谓的国际LGBT运动以来，LGBT人士及其支持者面临任意起诉。‘Coming Out’组织表示，尽管预料到这一结果，仍将继续为俄罗斯及流亡的LGBT群体提供支持。该组织被认定为极端组织后，其活动人士面临最高十年监禁的风险。俄罗斯司法部还对另外两个LGBT组织提起类似诉讼。国际社会应呼吁克里姆林宫停止对LGBT群体的打压，并为受迫害者提供庇护和保护。

content: (NEXSTAR) – Once again, the folks behind the massively popular Pokémon franchise have been forced to distance themselves from the Trump administration’s use of its imagery on social media. The White House, in a post shared to Instagram and X on Thursday morning, shared an image seemingly taken from the cover of the new “Pokémon Pokopia” video game, albeit with the words “Make America Great Again” written across the picture in a playful font. The posts’ captions included the acronym “MAGA” as well as a lightning-bolt emoji — the latter perhaps referencing the Pokémon character Pikachu. The White House did not appear to link its Pokémon-themed imagery to any specific event or policy, although the posts coincided with the release of “Pokémon Pokopia” on March 5. In a statement obtained by The Hill, a spokesperson for The Pokémon Company International distanced itself from the White House’s posts. “We are aware of recent social content that includes imagery associated with our brand,” reads the statement. “We were not involved in its creation or distribution, and no permission was granted for the use of our intellectual property. Our mission is to bring the world together, and that mission is not affiliated with any political viewpoint or agenda.” The Pokémon Company had also issued a similar statement in Sept. 2025, after the U.S. Department of Homeland Security used the “Pokémon” theme song to score a video of ICE agents carrying out detainments. The video also had a caption reading, “Gotta Catch ‘Em All,” a popular catchphrase from the Pokémon franchise. At the end of the video, the faces of some of the detainees are pictured on game cards that resemble those used by Pokémon fans. “Our company was not involved in the creation or distribution of this content, and permission was not granted for the use of our intellectual property,” the company said at the time. The Sept. 2025 video, meanwhile, is still active on the social media account for the Department of Homeland Security. The Pokémon Company is far from the only person or entity to distance themselves from the Trump administration and its use of their content or intellectual property. In Sept. 2025, comedian and podcaster Theo Von asked the DHS to remove a clip of him from one of the agency’s “deportation videos,” claiming he didn’t share DHS’ stance on immigration. Kesha, earlier this month, also clarified that she never gave permission for the White House to use her song “Blow” in a social media post, saying she was disgusted with its inclusion. Radiohead’s Jonny Greenwood, along with “One Battle After Another” director Paul Thomas Anderson, also recently objected to the music from their film “The Phantom Thread” being used in the “Melania” documentary, but a producer for “Melania” has since claimed that the music was obtained legally.
title: Pokémon Company calls out White House over game-themed ‘MAGA’ post
movement_title: 白宫使用精灵宝可梦图片引公司抗议
movement_abstract: 美国白宫在社交媒体上使用了《精灵宝可梦》的图片，并添加了‘Make America Great Again’字样，引发《精灵宝可梦》公司的抗议。该公司表示未参与相关内容的创作或分发，且未授权使用其知识产权。此前，美国国土安全部曾使用《精灵宝可梦》主题曲及形象进行相关视频，同样遭到公司反对。该公司强调其使命是团结世界，不与任何政治立场挂钩。类似事件还包括喜剧演员Theo Von、歌手Kesha等对特朗普政府使用其内容表示不满。

content: Check out episode two of The Joint Special Operations University’s ! “Episode 2: AI All the Time? The Future of Military Education with Dr. James Lacey” Artificial intelligence is rapidly transforming professional military education (PME)—not as a distant possibility, but as a present reality. In this episode, Dr. James Lacey, Horner Chair of War Studies at the Marine Corps University, makes a bold and controversial argument: resisting AI in the classroom is no longer a viable option. Instead, he contends that PME must move decisively toward full integration, or “all AI, all the time,” to prepare military leaders for the realities of modern and future warfare. Drawing on his firsthand experience redesigning curriculum around AI-enabled learning, Dr. Lacey explains how AI is already reshaping how students research, write, and think. He argues that AI can dramatically accelerate learning, free officers from administrative burdens, and allow educators to shift from lecturing to coaching. Dr. Lacey addresses concerns about academic integrity, intellectual dependency, and faculty resistance, while arguing that failure to adopt AI risks making institutions and educators strategically irrelevant. He emphasizes that tomorrow’s officers will fight alongside AI-enabled systems, and their education must reflect that reality today. – Why resisting AI in professional military education may already be a strategic mistake – How AI is transforming curriculum design, student learning, and faculty roles – Whether AI strengthens or undermines critical thinking among experienced military professionals – How AI may redefine assessment, teaching methods, and the purpose of PME itself – Why AI literacy will be essential for future officers operating in AI-enabled and AI-driven warfare – The future of military education will not simply include artificial intelligence, it will depend on leaders who understand how to learn, think, and fight alongside it. – Website: jsou.edu – LinkedIn: linkedin.com/company/thinkjsou – X: https:X.com/thinkjsou – Facebook: facebook.com/thinkjsou/ – YouTube: ThinkJSOU – Instagram: instagram.com/thinkjsou/
title: JSOU’s SOF Professional Podcast | AI and the Future of Military Education
movement_title: AI在军事教育中的全面整合与未来影响
movement_abstract: 本期节目探讨了人工智能（AI）在军事教育中的应用。Dr. James Lacey认为，拒绝在军事教育中使用AI已不再可行，军事教育必须全面整合AI技术，以培养适应现代和未来战争的领导者。他指出，AI正在改变学生的研究、写作和思维方式，能够加速学习、减轻行政负担，并使教育者从授课转向指导。尽管存在关于学术诚信、依赖性和教师抵触的担忧，但Dr. Lacey强调，不采用AI可能导致教育机构和教师变得战略上无关紧要。他强调，未来的军官将与AI系统并肩作战，因此教育必须反映这一现实。

content: Health tech giant TriZetto has confirmed that more than 3.4 million people’s personal and health information was stolen in a 2024 cyberattack, which the company failed to detect for almost a year. The tech company, owned by multinational conglomerate Cognizant , serves around 200 million people across 875,000 healthcare providers throughout the U.S., according to its website. Doctors’ offices and healthcare providers use TriZetto to assess patients’ insurance for medical treatments. TriZetto said in a filing with Maine’s attorney general on Friday that hackers stole patients’ insurance eligibility transaction reports from the company’s servers. The data includes personal information like patients’ names, dates of birth, home addresses, and Social Security numbers, as well as information about their healthcare, such as their provider’s name, demographic data, and health and insurance details. TriZetto said it identified the breach on October 2, 2025, but later discovered that the hackers had access as far back as November 2024. A spokesperson for Cognizant did not immediately respond to a request for comment, including why it took the company a year to detect the breach. Several organizations have confirmed that their patients’ information was compromised in the cyberattack. One of these is OCHIN , a nonprofit consultancy firm that provides healthcare technology to some 300 rural and community care providers across the United States. Other healthcare providers across California have also confirmed. According to TriZetto, not every customer was affected by the breach. TriZetto is the latest major health tech company to confirm a hack in recent years. In 2024, a ransomware attack at Change Healthcare , another health tech giant that processes some 15 billion healthcare transactions, allowed hackers to make off with more than 192 million patient files . The cyberattack sparked outages across the U.S., leaving many without access to medical treatments or medications.
title: TriZetto confirms 3.4M people’s health and personal data was stolen during breach
movement_title: TriZetto确认340万患者信息遭黑客窃取
movement_abstract: 美国健康科技公司TriZetto确认，2024年发生的一次网络攻击导致超过340万人的个人和健康信息被盗，公司直至2025年10月2日才察觉。该公司的服务器被黑客窃取了患者保险资格交易报告，包含姓名、出生日期、住址、社会安全号码以及医疗信息。黑客的入侵持续至2024年11月，公司未及时发现。此次事件是近年来另一家大型健康科技公司Change Healthcare遭遇勒索软件攻击后的又一案例，后者导致超过19200万份患者文件被盗，引发美国医疗系统中断。

content: A video of a Ukrainian ammunition depot exploding in March 2017 has been misrepresented on social media as showing Iranian missiles ‌striking an Israeli nuclear site in 2026. An X post , opens new tab sharing the video on March 1 claimed Israel's Dimona reactor had been destroyed. The post has been viewed 1.6 million times. Reuters Image Reuters found no credible reports that ⁠Dimona was hit by Iranian missiles fired in response to Israeli and U.S. airstrikes on February 28. Four days later, Iran's semi-official ISNA news agency cited an Iranian military official as threatening to target the site if Israel and the U.S. sought regime change. The footage shared on X is also unrelated to the current escalation in the Middle ‌East. A ⁠longer, higher-quality version of the video was uploaded to YouTube , opens new tab on March 23, 2017 (timestamp 01:57). Part of its caption said in English: “Ukraine Balakleya is burning and an ammunition depot is exploding.” Reuters ⁠confirmed the location as Balakliia, Ukraine, by matching buildings , opens new tab in the clip to satellite imagery on Yandex Maps. Reuters Image Reuters reported explosions at a ⁠warehouse storing tank ammunition in Balakliia on March 23, 2017, the same day the YouTube video was posted. VERDICT Miscaptioned. ⁠The video shows an ammunitions depot explosion in Balakliia, Ukraine, in 2017. This article was produced by the Reuters Fact Check team. Read more about our fact-checking work. title: Fact Check: Ukraine depot blast video falsely implied to show Iran striking Israeli nuclear site
movement_title: 乌克兰弹药库爆炸视频被误标为伊朗袭击以色列核设施
movement_abstract: 一段2017年3月乌克兰弹药库爆炸的视频被错误地在社交媒体上标注为2026年伊朗导弹袭击以色列迪莫纳核设施的事件。该视频在X平台上传后获得160万次观看，但路透社调查发现并无可信报道称迪莫纳曾被伊朗导弹击中。伊朗半官方媒体曾引用军方官员威胁若以色列和美国寻求政权更迭将袭击该设施。视频内容与当前中东局势无关，且视频来源为2017年3月23日上传的YouTube视频，标注为乌克兰巴尔塔利亚弹药库爆炸。路透社通过比对卫星图像确认视频地点为乌克兰巴尔塔利亚，且该地确实在同一天发生过弹药库爆炸。最终结论为视频被错误标注。

content: (中央社雅加達6日綜合外電報導)印尼政府今天宣布,考量到兒童面臨的網路色情、霸凌、詐騙及上網成癮威脅,本月28日起分階段禁止未滿16歲者使用社群媒體,成為首個採取這類措施的非西方國家。 綜合法新社和日經亞洲(Nikkei Asia)報導,印尼通訊與數位部長穆迪雅(Meutya Hafid)透過聲明表示:「高風險平台上屬於16歲以下兒童的帳號將開始遭到停用,從YouTube、TikTok、臉書(Facebook)、Instagram、Threads、X、Bigo Live和Roblox開始。」 她補充說:「政府如今介入,家長便不必再單獨對抗善於演算法的巨擘公司。」 澳洲去年12月已要求TikTok、YouTube、Snapchat等平台移除16歲以下用戶帳號。法國、丹麥、希臘和西班牙也不斷推動歐洲聯盟(EU)採取類似行動,歐盟的1個專家小組本週已開始研議。印度同樣正在考慮祭出青少年社群媒體禁令。 穆迪雅指出,政府理解新規一開始可能會為印尼用戶帶來一些不便,但「在數位緊急狀況下,這是政府必須採取的最佳步驟」。 她表示,禁令將分階段實施,「直到所有平台履行其合規義務為止」。(編譯:張正芊)1150306 本網站之文字、圖片及影音,非經授權,不得轉載、公開播送或公開傳輸及利用。
title: 印尼禁止未滿16歲者使用社群媒體 開非西方國家先例
movement_title: 印尼將分階段禁止未滿16歲者使用社群媒體
movement_abstract: 印尼政府宣布自本月28日起分階段禁止未滿16歲者使用社群媒體，成為首個採取這類措施的非西方國家。通訊與數位部長穆迪雅表示，高風險平台上的16歲以下兒童帳號將被停用，包括YouTube、TikTok、Facebook等。政府表示此舉旨在應對網路色情、霸凌、詐騙及上網成癮等威脅，並強調家長不必再單獨對抗科技巨擘。澳洲、法國、丹麥等國亦有類似措施或議題討論，印度亦在考慮推行青少年社群媒體禁令。

content: TAMPA, Fla. (WFLA) — Reports of AI-generated images showing fake videos of the conflict in Iran are spreading across social media. Experts at the University of South Florida shared how to debunk those images. Some say war is about deception. But some of the AI generated videos spreading online about the war in Iran can mislead anyone about a very real conflict. The fake content shows buildings burning, some of them toppling over, and massive missiles being transported in the streets. Dr. Jordan Howell, an assistant professor in USF’s Department of Criminology, said you can detect flaws in AI videos by using software to cross-reference the images and by checking with reputable sources to see if it’s real or not. “In current geopolitical context, AI has allowed propaganda at scale, and it’s really hard for individuals to know what information is real,” Howell added. There are also videos like what the White House posted on social platform X, merging video game scenarios with real Department of Defense footage of the war in Iran. “The White House, along with our adversaries, are engaged in a war of public opinion and sentiment,” Howell said. The profresser explained AI can and will be used in combat situations. The technology could help locate and strike targets without putting troops on the ground. Howell added that the tech would still need human oversight, and could be dangerous to not use this tech. “As technology advances, so too does warfare. And modern warfare is going to be, you know, who has the best AI,” he said. Chad Mairn, a professor at St. Petersburg College, recommends using the “SIFT” method for identifying fake videos:
title: Fake Iran images show AI used as a weapon of ‘public opinion,’ USF experts say
movement_title: AI生成虚假视频误导公众 专家呼吁辨别真伪
movement_abstract: 文章讨论了AI生成的虚假视频在社交媒体上广泛传播的问题，尤其是与伊朗冲突相关的虚假内容。专家指出，这些视频可能误导公众对真实冲突的认知，例如展示建筑物燃烧、导弹运输等场景。美国佛罗里达州立大学的Jordan Howell教授建议通过软件交叉验证图像和参考权威来源来辨别AI视频的真实性。他强调AI技术在现代战争中的应用，包括远程打击目标，但需有人工监督以避免风险。此外，白宫在社交媒体上发布的视频结合了游戏画面与真实国防部影像，引发对舆论战的讨论。文章指出AI在信息战中的影响力日益增强，未来战争将取决于谁掌握更先进的AI技术。

content: 網傳「中國向伊朗出售超音速反艦飛彈,鎖死美國航母」? 這是AI生成的內容農場影片,內容誇大不實 美國、以色列於2月28日對伊朗展開「史詩怒火行動」,網路流傳影片聲稱中國出售超音速反艦飛彈給伊朗,美軍航母被徹底鎖死;經查證,網傳影片是由AI生成的內容農場影片,其說法未獲證實,軍事描述也過於誇大,並非可信的消息來源。 一、網傳影片稱中國將向伊朗出售超音速反艦巡航飛彈,但中國外交部公開否認相關說法,並批評此為「惡意關聯炒作」。 軍事專家表示,即使中國有意對伊朗出售武器,但在目前國際情勢下短期內難以交付,過程可能遭攔截。 二、傳言宣稱中國超音速反艦飛彈能躲避航艦雷達;但軍事專家指出,美軍航艦有配備公羊飛彈等近迫防禦武器和預警機可攔截此類威脅。網傳影片對飛彈性能的描述過於誇大,整體說法並不可信。 三、網傳影片並未引述任何官方資訊或主流媒體報導,且具備虛構內容的AI生成影片特徵,並非可信的消息來源。 中國並未證實軍援伊朗,網傳AI生成影片的描述也過於誇大,易生誤解。 背景 美國、以色列2月28日凌晨宣布對伊朗發動「史詩怒火行動」,伊朗隨即進行報復反擊。隨後,社群平台流傳一段影片,聲稱「中國當著全世界的面做出極其霸氣的舉動,伊朗即將向中國購買一批超音速反艦巡航導彈,鎖死美國航空母艦」等。 查核 查核點:網傳影片說法是真的嗎? 中國否認出售超音速反艦飛彈給伊朗 針對網傳影片聲稱「中國當著全世界的面做出極其霸氣的舉動,伊朗即將向中國購買一批超音速反艦巡航導彈」等說法,查核中心檢視新聞媒體是否有相關報導。 根據《中央社》報導,中國外交部發言人毛寧3日於例行記者會時,澄清伊朗採購中國超音速反艦飛彈的報導不屬實,否認軍援伊朗,並稱中方反對「惡意關聯炒作」。 不過,《自由時報》也刊出報導稱,伊朗向中國採購的超音速反艦飛彈,原訂3月上旬交貨,但中國在伊朗受美軍「史詩怒火行動」襲擊的第一時間,就已經向駐伊朗大使館下令,要求立刻銷毀所有軍售、援助計畫及石油採購等資料。 國防安全研究院中共政軍與作戰概念研究所副研究員舒孝煌表示,中國雖然不承認出售超音速反艦飛彈給伊朗,但基於伊朗為中國盟友,且中國急於擴大自身影響力,確實可能出售武器;不過,依目前國際情勢判斷,就算中國真的欲出售飛彈給伊朗,近期內也無法交付,否則可能在機場或港口就已被攔截。 航空母艦有設置近迫武器來對付超音速反艦飛彈 網傳影片聲稱,中國欲出售給伊朗的超音速反艦飛彈射程290公里,不但能躲避美國航空母艦雷達的偵測,還可利用超音速壓縮美軍的反應時間,使攔截成功率呈現斷崖式的暴跌。 對此,舒孝煌表示,美國早就預見此威脅,因此已把裝設在航艦、水面艦上的近迫武器換成公羊飛彈(RAM),專門用來對付超音速反艦飛彈。而且航艦預警也不是只靠艦上雷達,而是預警機,預警機飛在一萬多呎高空,偵測距離4、500公里以上,像美國採用的就是E-2D鷹眼預警機。 針對傳言提到中國超音速反艦飛彈射程,舒孝煌分析指出,一般而言航艦不會靠岸290公里那麼近,以台灣的雄3超音速反艦飛彈來說,空射型的射程甚至可達400公里。 舒孝煌表示,假如網傳影片的理論為真,中國的福建號航空母艦同樣也會面臨超音速反艦飛彈的威脅,而且福建號上的近迫武器還沒有美國的公羊飛彈好,豈不是更容易被攻擊?由此可判斷此類影片內容都有過度誇大的問題,也並不可信。 這是AI生成的內容農場影片 查核中心檢視發布網傳影片的YouTube頻道,該頻道成立於2025年底,距今3個月已經發布超過100支影片,主題都與中國、美國、日本、俄羅斯政治外交及軍事相關。 這些影片的標題聳動,如「美軍3大神話破滅」、「美印日陷入絕望」、「解放軍的導彈都豎起來了」等,但細看其內容則並未引述任何官方資訊或主流媒體報導,且具備虛構內容的AI生成影片特徵,並非可信的消息來源。
title: 中國否認軍援伊朗,網傳AI影片對超音速反艦飛彈的描述也過於誇大
movement_title: AI生成影片夸大中国向伊朗出售超音速导弹
movement_abstract: 网络流传一段AI生成的影片，声称中国向伊朗出售超音速反舰导弹，以锁定美国航母。经查证，该影片为AI生成内容，未获证实，且军事描述夸大不实。中国外交部已否认相关说法，并批评其为‘恶意关联炒作’。军事专家指出，即使中国有意出售武器，短期内难以交付，且美国航母具备多种防御系统，如公羊导弹与预警机，可有效拦截此类威胁。此外，影片未引用任何官方或主流媒体报道，具有虚构特征，可信度极低。

title: 網傳「金正恩軍援伊朗、參戰」為錯誤訊息
movement_title: 朝鲜未宣布提供导弹或参战，传言缺乏依据
movement_abstract: 近期社交媒体流传消息称，朝鲜领导人金正恩愿意提供导弹帮助伊朗，并将加入伊朗对抗美国的战争。但经核查，朝鲜官方并未作出相关声明，金正恩的公开活动和谈话中也未提及此类内容。该传言源自国外社交媒体账号，缺乏可靠消息来源，且被翻译成中文后进一步扩散。美国与以色列于2月28日对伊朗发动军事攻击，伊朗亦予以反击，但朝鲜仅在3月1日发表声明谴责美以行动，未提及任何军事援助或参战意图。因此，相关传言缺乏依据，属于错误信息。

content: “When all you have is a hammer, everything begins to look like a nail” is a well-known cognitive bias known as the Law of the Instrument or . Psychologist observed that “it is tempting, if the only tool you have is a hammer, to treat everything as if it were a nail,” illustrating how reliance on familiar tools or perspectives can narrow problem framing and blind decision-makers to alternative approaches. Immediately following the U.S. to capture Venezuelan leader on January 6, 2026, the language used to describe events narrowed and hardened. What had been discussed as and a risk was reframed as a technical problem of . Consequences that had been debated were redescribed as unavoidable. Strikes were presented as limited and calibrated. Officials spoke in the vocabulary of . By the time public justification arrived, the moral question was no longer open. What remained was execution. But not all problems are the same, and treating them as if they are one of the most reliable paths to failure. As others and I have , not all challenges warrant the same institutional response. In policy studies and leadership research, a foundational distinction exists between different . A traditional policy and military distinction between command (appropriate for immediate crises), management (appropriate for routine governance), and leadership(necessary for open-ended or “wicked” problems), which map directly onto how problems are framed institutionally, and whether responses are rewarded or punished. This framing originates in Horst Rittel and Melvin Webber’s article on planning and policy failure. Using a softer typology today, we can have three basic categories of problem-styles: tame, crisis, and wicked problems. Tame problems are complicated but solvable through expertise and management. demand : time is short, information is incomplete, and authority centralizes to prevent immediate harm. But a third category—wicked problems— both management and command. Wicked problems have no definitive formulation, no stopping rule, and no solution that does not reshape the problem itself. Leadership scholars have mapped this distinction onto practice: command is appropriate for acute crises; management for routine governance; and leadership—understood as a relational process between leaders and followers—is necessary for wicked problems. for example, articulates this mapping explicitly in his work on leadership and problem types. Subsequent scholarship shows that wicked problems are embedded in social and political complexity and cannot be resolved through technical fixes or coercive decisiveness. They require adaptive leadership, learning, and the sustained participation of followers rather than . See, for example, of wicked problems in public policy. In the high fantasy three-volume saga of the character of Boromir is one of tragic figures: a great leader of men, Boromir follows a prophetic vision to Rivendell to join the Fellowship in their quest to destroy the evil magic Ring. Convinced that the Ring is a weapon that could be used to save the home and the people that he loves, Boromir attempts to convince Frodo to let him have the Ring (temporarily, of course). But when that plan of persuasion fails, he takes the ring from the hobbit by force. The failure dramatizes through Boromir is not a failure to be virtuous. It is a failure to recognize what kind of problem is being faced. Note that throughout the saga, Boromir’s home of Gondor lives under conditions of near-permanent threat. Over generations, this can produce a dangerous misclassification. What may once have been a crisis becomes treated as eternal. Emergency hardens into identity. When every challenge is framed as existential, command becomes the default mode of governance, and force becomes the most legible form of competence. Boromir is decisive, even when he is decisively wrong, because he is exceptionally well-adapted to a system that rewards decisive action under threat. He is shaped by his institutional culture long before he reaches for the Ring. A real-world analogue helps clarify the dynamic. The late U.S. Naval War College professor offered an excellent example of how a culture can develop around a state’s strategic context in his assessment of Israel’s plight. Since its founding in 1948, Israel has more than once achieved remarkable operational and tactical victories against invading Arab armies. , however, as Handel points out, these victories may also have risked obscuring Israel’s deeper strategic vulnerabilities. His observation echoes that of political theorist Hannah Arendt, who warned in 1948 that a state forged under siege might come to organize its political life almost entirely around physical survival, crowding out broader social and political imagination. Read through a wicked-problems lens, this is not an argument about belligerence or ethics, but about misclassification. When historically rooted, relational conflicts are governed as permanent crises, command logic can harden into identity. Over time, force becomes not just a tool but the most legitimate form of responsibility. Alternatives recede from view not because they are absent, but because institutional reward structures no longer recognize them as serious. Tolkien’s Boromir, too, is shaped entirely within this cauldron of logic. He isn’t reckless. He’s especially well-adapted to a system that incentivizes certitude and direct action as duty. In a crisis frame, Boromir is exactly the kind of leader institutions select: decorated, confident, forceful, intolerant of delay, and morally certain. Note that when Boromir first arrives at the Council of Elrond, he is confronted by a fundamentally different framing. The Ring is presented not as a crisis problem to be neutralized through command, but rather as a kind of wicked problem. Any attempt to dominate it reproduces the very conditions it is meant to end. He is warned that any sense of control over the Ring is an illusion. He is told that escalation and violence feed the enemy’s logic. These are not abstract or magical cautionary tales but systems-level analyses. But, instead of accepting this new classification, Boromir argues that Gondor deserves the use of the Ring. This isn’t arrogance, but a sense of entitlement. He insists that Gondor has suffered the most, holding the line. Therefore, Gondor deserves it. Accordingly, Boromir rejects the Council’s warnings not because he is a fool, but because accepting the new framing would invalidate the only form of responsibility his political culture recognizes. He rejects them because accepting them would require abandoning the crisis frame that gives his role meaning. , as policy scholars note, shapes which responses are even visible to decision-makers. Consequently, Boromir’s forced taking of the Ring is less a betrayal than it is institutional compliance. Faced with a problem that cannot be solved by mere force, Boromir uses force anyway, because force is the only solution his system recognizes. This is where matters. In a healthy response to wicked problems, followers do more than execute orders. They question framing, surface long-term consequences, and, through a practice of , resist false urgency. Tolkien encodes this contrast in Faramir, Boromir’s younger brother, who listens, reflects, and refuses what he cannot control. Faramir practices leadership without command. Above them sits Denethor, their father and the Steward of Gondor, who mistakenly believes he can control a (one of several crystal balls in the stories), secretly using it to search out Sauron’s strength. His governance is defined by secrecy and overconfidence, mistaking the hoarding and control of information for wisdom. Denethor favors Boromir but resents Faramir, for in systems like this, the reward structure favors escalation, prizes decisiveness and force, but makes restraint and reflection invisible. In wicked problems, these moments of recognition or misclassification are pivotal. When beset with wicked problems, institutions must either recognize the problem as such and shift from command to leadership or else they end up doubling down on coercion. Gondor doubles down. In the Ring, Boromir sees an opportunity to convert a wicked problem back into a crisis—something that can be ended decisively, quickly, and through overwhelming power. The move for the Ring comes not from temptation for personal power and mere domination but from a desire for resolution, certainty, and closure. The long ambiguity of survival gives way to the fantasy of the final victory. Boromir’s remorse arrives only when consequences become immediate and personal. But wicked problems rarely provide such clarity in time. Research on wicked problems underscores that coercive solutions rather than resolve challenges. By the time damage is undeniable, it is usually irreversible and unforgettable to those who are harmed. The parallels to the real world are not merely allegorical. They are procedural, institutional, and ideological. They follow in line, from the narrative that action was urgent to the framing of escalation as reluctant but unavoidable stewardship. The certainty of technocratic management to contain the chaos of a wicked problem after the application of force and direct action. shows that governments use framing in perceived crisis situations not just to explain events but also to . Framing affects how publics perceive decisions as necessary or inevitable, shaping political support or resistance. When situations are framed as permanent crises rather than wicked problems—complex, historical, and entangled with regional and global systems—command logic dominates. Those who advocate force appear responsible. Those who urge restraint, engagement, or long-term transformation are dismissed and brushed aside as naïve, feckless, or worse, or disloyal. on crisis framing shows how political actors construct crises to legitimate otherwise controversial actions. This is Tolkien’s insight and warning: that once force is normalized, it becomes self-justifying. Each unintended consequence demands more decisiveness. Each failure reinforces the claim that delay was the original sin. Emergency becomes permanent. Force becomes a reflex. Boromir’s catastrophe, then, is not a warning about mere temptation. His failure is a warning about profound misclassification—about what happens when wicked problems are governed as crises and when institutions reward command while starving leadership, when restraint is seen as weakness and decisive force is mistaken for thoughtful analysis. In such systems, force and violence do not merely become options. They become the only solutions anyone is allowed to see.
title: When Crisis Becomes Culture: Boromir, Wicked Problems, and the Reward of Force
movement_title: 认知偏差与复杂问题治理的误判分析
movement_abstract: 文章讨论了‘工具依赖’的认知偏差，即人们倾向于用熟悉的工具或视角解决所有问题，从而限制了问题的框架和决策的多样性。以美国2026年对委内瑞拉领导人的行动为例，事件被重新定义为技术问题，后果被描述为不可避免，从而掩盖了道德层面的讨论。文章进一步区分了不同类型的政策问题：驯服问题（tame）、危机问题（crisis）和复杂问题（wicked）。其中，复杂问题没有明确的解决方案，需要适应性领导、学习和参与者的持续参与。文章以《魔戒》中的波罗米尔为例，说明当问题被误判为永恒危机时，决策者可能倾向于使用强制手段，而忽视了更深层次的社会和政治复杂性。最后，文章以以色列的战略困境为例，指出长期处于危机状态的国家可能将生存置于政治想象力之上，导致治理模式僵化。

content: (中央社華盛頓5日綜合外電報導)美國五角大廈今天正式將人工智慧(AI)實驗室Anthropic列為「供應鏈風險」企業,限制其技術在軍事行動的使用。有消息人士稱,該技術被用於針對伊朗的軍事行動。 路透社報導,Anthropic在聲明中證實,「供應鏈風險」標籤將立即生效,並禁止政府承包商在執行美國軍事任務時,使用Anthropic的技術。 但Anthropic執行長阿莫戴(Dario Amodei)在聲明中寫道,企業仍可在與五角大廈無關的其他專案中使用 Anthropic的Claude模型。他還說,這些限制僅適用於在五角大廈合約中使用Anthropic AI的行為。 此次列入風險名單源於雙方長達數月的爭議。Anthropic堅持在技術中加入安全護欄,但戰爭部則認為這些限制過於極端。阿莫戴在聲明中重申,Anthropic將就該風險標籤提出訴訟。 阿莫戴今天在聲明中指出,Anthropic近日已與五角大廈討論停止使用Claude模型的可行計畫。他表示,雙方也探討如何在不拆除安全防護機制的情況下,讓Anthropic繼續與軍方合作。 阿莫戴也對昨天由科技新聞網站The Information披露的內部備忘錄致歉。他在這份於2月27日撰寫的備忘錄中直言,五角大廈官員不喜歡該公司的部分原因在於「我們沒有像對待獨裁者那樣,對川普極盡讚美。」 就在投資人忙著為Anthropic與五角大廈鬧僵後的殘局止血時,這份內部備忘錄的曝光無疑是雪上加霜。 戰爭部尚未立即回應置評請求。(編譯:陳昱婷)1150306 本網站之文字、圖片及影音,非經授權,不得轉載、公開播送或公開傳輸及利用。

movement_title: 美国五角大楼将Anthropic列为供应链风险企业
movement_abstract: 美国五角大楼正式将人工智能公司Anthropic列为‘供应链风险’企业，限制其技术在军事行动中的使用。据消息人士称，该技术被用于针对伊朗的军事行动。Anthropic在声明中确认该标签立即生效，禁止政府承包商在执行美军任务时使用其技术。但公司CEO阿莫戴表示，企业仍可在与五角大楼无关的其他项目中使用Claude模型。此次列入风险名单源于双方数月的争议，Anthropic坚持加入安全护栏，但五角大楼认为限制过于极端。阿莫戴称将就该标签提起诉讼，并表示双方已讨论停止使用Claude模型的计划，同时探讨在不拆除安全机制的情况下继续与军方合作的可能。此外，阿莫戴对一份内部备忘录致歉，其中提及五角大楼官员不满公司未像对待特朗普那样赞美他。

content: (中央社記者潘智義台北6日電)台泥旗下台泥儲能今天宣布,自主研發的儲能能源管理系統(EMS),正式通過國際第三方驗證機構的國際工控資安標準驗證,為台泥儲能攜手台泥歐洲能源子公司、輸出「台灣研發」儲能電力應用模式至歐洲及全球電網,取得了關鍵的國際通行證。 台泥儲能表示,目前主力業務是在歐洲建立以儲能為中心的微電網,參與充電、電力交易市場為主。歐洲對於關鍵基礎設施的網路安全,有極為嚴苛的法律規範與技術門檻。在歐美電網專案中,具備系統級資安驗證已從「加分題」轉變為「必備題」。 台泥強調,透過此次取得的IEC 62443-3-3 SL2驗證,台泥儲能成功證明自主研發的EMS,已達到國際關鍵電力基礎設施認可的系統級資安防護水準,能在高度聯網的儲能環境中有效防禦惡意攻擊,為儲能「數位大腦」築起國際頂規安全防線。 台泥表示,取得驗證後,台泥儲能與歐洲能源子公司深度協作,在參與歐洲大型電力系統標案時,能無縫對接國際電力與電網公司的高標準資安要求,大幅縮短技術審查期,提升全球競爭力。 對於產業而言,台泥說明,EMS猶如儲能系統的「智慧指揮中心」與「數位大腦」,負責監控數以萬計的電池單元、調度電力充放,並與雲端及國家電網即時連線。 台泥說明,儲能此次通過的IEC 62443-3-3 系統層級驗證,與市場上常見的單一硬體零件認證不同,必須確保整套EMS在高度聯網環境下,從身分驗證、存取控制、數據加密到異常事件應變,皆達到Security by Design的頂級防禦水準。目前在台灣儲能產業中,台泥儲能是少數擁有自主研發能力並取得SL2系統層級認證的業者。(編輯:張良知)1150306 本網站之文字、圖片及影音,非經授權,不得轉載、公開播送或公開傳輸及利用。
title: 台泥儲能管理系統獲國際驗證 迎歐洲基建商機
movement_title: 台泥儲能EMS通過國際工控資安認證
movement_abstract: 台泥旗下台泥儲能宣布其自主研發的儲能能源管理系統（EMS）已通過國際第三方驗證機構的國際工控資安標準驗證，取得IEC 62443-3-3 SL2系統層級認證。此認證有助於台泥儲能與歐洲能源子公司合作，將台灣的儲能電力應用模式輸出至歐洲及全球電網。EMS作為儲能系統的「智慧指揮中心」，負責監控電池單元、調度電力充放，並與雲端及國家電網即時連線。此次認證顯示台泥儲能的EMS達到國際關鍵電力基礎設施的系統級資安防護水準，能在高度聯網環境中有效防禦惡意攻擊，提升全球競爭力。

content: 網傳圖片「伊朗官媒公布哈米尼死亡的照片」? AI生成影像,伊朗沒有公布哈米尼身亡影像 伊朗最高領袖哈米尼(Ayatollah Ali Khamenei)於美、以兩國襲擊中喪生,伊朗當局也證實消息。隨後社群平台流傳圖片宣稱伊朗官媒公布哈米尼死亡的照片。該圖片其實為AI生成,非真實照片。 一、檢視伊朗國營媒體《Iran International》、《伊通社》、《法斯通訊社》,及國際通訊社《美聯社》、《路透社》、《BBC》等網站,皆未看見網傳圖片,也無任何媒體發布哈米尼的身亡照片。 二、透過AI生成圖像檢測工具《Hive Moderation》、《Sightengine》,檢測結果均顯示網傳圖片有高機率為AI生成。 Google SynthID系統更指出網傳圖片是由Google AI生成。 三、多國的查核組織《Leadstories》、《The Quint》、《CONGO CHECK》查證結果均顯示網傳圖片為AI生成。 美國與伊朗都已證實哈米尼死於空襲,但網傳圖片是AI生成的虛構影像,並非真實畫面。 背景 隨後社群平台流傳圖片宣稱「伊朗官媒終於承認哈梅內伊死亡並公佈了實況錄像與照片」,畫面顯示一名臉部經馬賽克處理的人物被壓在建築物碎片之下。另外,也有人物臉部未經馬賽克的圖片版本。 查核 查核點:網傳圖片是真實影像嗎? 實為AI生成,非真實畫面 (一)檢視伊朗國營媒體《Iran International》、《伊通社》、《法斯通訊社》,及國際通訊社《美聯社》、《路透社》、《BBC》等網站,皆未看見網傳圖片,也無任何媒體發布哈米尼的身亡照片。 (二)透過AI生成圖像檢測工具《Hive Moderation》、《Sightengine》,檢測結果均顯示網傳圖片有高機率為AI生成,非真實影像。 此外, Google 「SynthID」功能可以鑑別Google旗下AI模型(如 Imagen、Gemini、Veo 等)所生成的影像。SynthID系統顯示也指出網傳圖片為Google AI生成。 (三)網傳圖片在多個國家流傳,多間查核組織《Leadstories》、《The Quint》、《CONGO CHECK》的查證結果均顯示為AI生成。
title: 網傳圖片「伊朗官媒公布哈米尼遇襲畫面」是AI生成的影像
movement_title: 网传哈米尼死亡照片实为AI生成
movement_abstract: 网传图片显示伊朗官媒公布哈米尼死亡的照片，但经核查并非真实影像，而是AI生成。伊朗最高领袖哈米尼在美以两国空袭中丧生，伊朗当局已证实消息。然而，社交媒体流传的图片被证实为AI生成，多家国际媒体和AI检测工具均未发现该图片，且Google SynthID系统指出其由Google AI生成。多国查核组织也确认该图片为AI生成，非真实画面。

content: (中央社記者鍾佑貞華盛頓5日專電)美國眾議員憂心中國學生學者聯合會(CSSA)缺乏充分監管,且於校園推動中共利益,已對美國國安造成重大風險,今天要求國務卿盧比歐將CSSA列為外國使團,這代表CSSA為中國政府的延伸,舉辦公開活動需獲國務院批准。 美國眾議院共和黨議員穆勒納爾(John Moolenaar)、馬斯特(Brian Mast)及沃伯格(Tim Walberg)致函盧比歐(Marco Rubio),要求他將CSSA指定為中國政府的外國使團(Foreign Mission)。 CSSA如果被列為外國使團,各分會將被要求在與地方政府及大學舉行任何會議前提前通知國務院,在美國舉辦公開活動前也需取得國務院的事前批准。 議員們在信中指出,1982年美國國會通過外國使團法(Foreign Missions Act),目的在確保對美國外交與領事機構在海外待遇的互惠,也規範外國使團在美國本土的活動,避免使團成員濫用特權與豁免。 議員們說,近幾十年來,敵對國家使團帶來的挑戰與日俱增。尤其是來自中國共產黨的威脅最為明顯。中共利用其擁有或控制的眾多幌子組織,透過其統戰戰略為其效力。 根據信件,統戰工作高度複雜,具接觸、影響與情報等多重操作手法,為中共塑造其政治環境並協助推進其戰略目標。統戰手法包括監控海外華人社群、宣傳親中敘事,以及騷擾、恐嚇中共批評者,甚至使其「消音」。 信中並舉例說明,美西南中國學生學者聯誼會(Southwest Chinese Students and Scholars Association)是已註冊的非營利組織,涵蓋42所美國大學,章程明確指出受中國領事館監督。 議員們表示,多個校園CSSA分會在社群媒體上宣稱,它們是各自校園唯一經當地領事館認可的官方中國學生組織,包括麻薩諸塞大學波士頓分校(University of Massachusetts Boston)、華盛頓大學(University of Washington)、加州大學聖巴巴拉分校(UC Santa Barbara)等。 信件提到,此外,一些CSSA分會的入會要求也包括對中國政府及其政策目標的效忠誓言。 根據2024年的國會報告,美國政府將22個實體認定為中國的外國使團,包括5個使領館、13家媒體、2家企業和2個與中共統戰體系直接相關的實體。 3名議員說,雖然這些認定對於透明度至關重要,但僅僅觸及了與中共影響力和情報機構相關組織的冰山一角。美方必須對以外國使團身分運作的中國實體保持警惕。 「正如美國國家情報總監辦公室2025年發布的非機密情報評估報告所強調,美國學術機構和學生是中共惡意影響行動的目標。」(編輯:謝怡璇)1150306 本網站之文字、圖片及影音,非經授權,不得轉載、公開播送或公開傳輸及利用。

movement_title: 美国众议员要求将中国学生学者联合会列为外国使团
movement_abstract: 美国众议员担忧中国学生学者联合会（CSSA）缺乏监管，并在校内推动中共利益，已对美国国家安全构成重大风险。他们要求国务卿卢比欧将CSSA列为外国使团，这意味着CSSA被视为中国政府的延伸，其公开活动需获得国务院批准。议员们指出，CSSA分会常声称是当地领事馆认可的官方中国学生组织，并要求成员效忠中国政策。根据2024年国会报告，美国已将22个实体认定为中国的外国使团，但认为这仅触及中共影响力和情报机构组织的冰山一角。议员强调，美国学术机构和学生是中共恶意影响行动的目标，需保持警惕。

content: (中央社記者鍾佑貞華盛頓5日專電)美國國會議員今天關切,美國如何與台灣等盟友合作,反擊中國代理人推動的「疑美論」。國務院次卿回應,美方反制作法包括推動獎學金交流計畫與深化人際互動,同時努力揭露中國「統一戰線」行動的資金投入。 美國聯邦眾議院外交事務委員會上午舉行「透過公共外交推進國家安全」聽證會,公共外交國務次卿羅傑斯(Sarah Rogers)出席作證。 共和黨籍眾議員巴爾(Andy Barr)曾提出「對抗中國惡意影響基金授權法案」。他關切,國務院目前如何因應中國影響力,以及美國應如何與台灣等盟友合作,反制中國代理人在印太區域推動的疑美論述。 「這涉及多個層面,而且至關重要。」羅傑斯表示,美方正透過交流獎學金計畫及人與人之間的互動接觸,取得具體成果。她舉例,美國曾在墨西哥推動宣傳活動,提醒民眾注意中國的經濟脅迫,以及北京在港口與基礎設施合作中提出的「魔鬼交易」。 印太區域方面,她指出,美方已達成數項關鍵礦產協議,以協助確保供應鏈安全,「我們也在努力揭露中國統戰行動的資金投入」。羅傑斯透露,她今年春天將首次出訪東亞與太平洋地區。 羅傑斯指出,印太地區擁有全球一半以上人口,並承載近半數全球商業活動。鑑於中國的對抗性戰略行動,印太對美國具有極重要的戰略意義。她說,印太區域內島鏈與夥伴國家正面臨中國宣傳與惡意影響力的影響,美國現階段所有針對中國的行動,都有助於強化自身印太戰略布局。 羅傑斯舉例,她近期取得授權,可要求、促使,必要時甚至強制美國大學提高外國資金來源透明度,這與美國在印太區域的影響力布局密切相關。 美國聯邦參議院調查小組於2019年曾發表報告,詳述中國對美國教育體系的影響,促使美國政府重新加強執行有關資訊揭露的規定。 美國教育部聲明指出,美國大學院校於2025年共申報8300筆、總額達52億美元(約新台幣1655億元)的資金往來,涵蓋來自各國政府、私人企業及個人,其中最大「金主」為卡達,有11億美元,其次為英國的6億3300萬美元,以及中國的5億2800萬美元。 羅傑斯今天也強調商業外交的重要性,指出經濟脅迫是中國主要工具之一。她說,美方正提醒各國警惕中國提出的「無法拒絕的條件」。 羅傑斯說:「事實上,各國應該拒絕,因為那些港口並非免費,基礎建設也未必如宣稱般完善。」 另有議員關切中國透過假訊息,操作影響索羅門群島選舉。羅傑斯表示,中國透過多種管道,將宣傳與資訊操作滲透到競爭激烈的國家。 她說,國務院正與社群媒體和科技公司協調,蒐集相關威脅資訊,例如外國機器人帳號群等。 羅傑斯指出,她已收到一份非常詳細的簡報,內容涉及中國在太平洋島國施加影響力的各種手段,包括滲透社群媒體聊天群組,以及收購或拉攏當地媒體,這類情況屢見不鮮。(編輯:陳妍君)1150306 本網站之文字、圖片及影音,非經授權,不得轉載、公開播送或公開傳輸及利用。

movement_title: 美国强化印太公共外交反制中国影响力渗透
movement_abstract: 美国国会关注如何与台湾等盟友合作，反制中国代理人推动的‘疑美论’。国务院次卿罗杰斯表示，美方通过奖学金交流、深化人际互动及揭露中国‘统一战线’资金投入等措施，加强公共外交以维护国家安全。她指出，印太地区面临中国宣传与影响力渗透，美国正通过关键矿产协议确保供应链安全，并推动大学提高外国资金透明度。美国教育部数据显示，2025年美国大学获得的外国资金总额达52亿美元，其中中国贡献5.28亿美元。罗杰斯强调，中国利用经济胁迫和虚假信息影响其他国家，美国正与科技公司合作搜集相关威胁信息，并关注中国在太平洋岛国的影响力渗透行为。

content: Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth on Thursday said there will “come a moment” when President Trump or the Iranian people decide to rise up against the government, though he stressed they should not protest during the ongoing U.S.-Israeli military campaign against the regime. “No one’s done more than President Trump to reopen the opportunity for those who want a free Iran to do so,” Hegseth said from U.S. Central Command (Centcom) headquarters in Florida. “Ultimately, it’s common sense, as he said up front, don’t go out and protest while bombs are dropping inside Tehran and elsewhere. There will come a moment where he determines, or they determine that it’s time to seize that advantage.” He added: “There’s a lot of things we’re doing, and the Israeli military is doing, targeting those individuals who are targeting those who protest. The more you do that, and you erode their will, and you erode their capabilities, the more you create an opportunity for people to boldly stand up.” Centcom Commander Adm. Brad Cooper, who spoke alongside Hegseth, clarified that strikes were targeting the headquarters and the people who are targeting protesters. Cooper also echoed Trump’s insistence that the Iranian people should “stay in your homes. Keep things calm. Stay out of the way.” More than 30,000 Iranians were estimated to have been killed in January alone after rooftop snipers and trucks mounted with heavy machine guns opened fire on millions of protesters in the streets. Tehran’s government shut down the internet and communications with the rest of the world and in the country, making it difficult to gather information on the incident. The Trump administration hopes that hammering Iran will spark a regime overthrow. “There’s a lot of U.S. and Israeli capacity coming over, we’re hitting a lot of targets, the best thing for them to do for right now is just to lay low,” Cooper noted. Hegseth also signaled that Washington will soon escalate its war with Iran, which will hit the one week mark on Saturday. “If you think you’ve seen something, just wait,” Hegseth said. “The amount of combat power that’s still flowing, that’s still coming, that we’ll be able to project over Iran is at multiples of what it currently is right now when you add up our capabilities and those of the Israeli Defense Forces.”
title: Hegseth suggests Iran strikes creating conditions for revolution
movement_title: 美国防长称伊朗民众将有机会反抗政府，呼吁保持冷静
movement_abstract: 美国国防部长彼得·海格塞思表示，美国总统特朗普或伊朗人民将有一个时机来反抗政府，但强调在美以联合军事行动期间不应进行抗议。他指出特朗普为伊朗自由提供了机会，并强调在空袭期间抗议的风险。中央司令部司令布拉德·库珀表示，袭击目标是针对抗议者的势力，同时呼吁伊朗民众保持冷静。据估计，仅1月就有超过3万名伊朗人死于抗议活动。特朗普政府希望通过打击伊朗引发政权更迭。海格塞思还暗示美国将加大对伊朗的军事行动，未来一周行动将升级。

content: Anthropic’s $200 million contract with the Department of Defense (DOD) broke down last week after the two parties failed to come to an agreement over the degree to which the military could obtain unrestricted access to Anthropic’s AI. When the DOD made a deal with OpenAI instead, it seemed that the military’s relationship with Anthropic would come to a close — but new reporting from the Financial Times and Bloomberg say that Amodei resumed negotiations with Pentagon official Emil Michael. These talks are reportedly part of an attempt to compromise on a contract that outlines how the Pentagon can continue to access Anthropic’s AI models. It would be a surprise to see Anthropic eek out a new deal, given how much vitriol has been exchanged among the parties involved. But a compromise could still hold appeal for both sides — the Pentagon already relies on Anthropic’s technology, and an abrupt switch to OpenAI’s systems would be disruptive. The dispute began when Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei voiced concern over a clause that allowed the military to use Anthropic’s AI for “any lawful use.” Amodei asserted that the company would not allow for its technology to be used for domestic mass surveillance or autonomous weaponry and wanted the contract to more clearly prohibit those uses. When Anthropic refused to comply, the DOD turned around and struck a deal with OpenAI instead. Since then, figures on both sides have been open about their frustrations. Michael called Amodei a “liar” with a “God complex.” Amodei threw some jabs of his own at the DOD and OpenAI CEO Sam Altman in a message reportedly sent to Anthropic staff this week, calling the OpenAI deal “safety theater” and the messaging around it “straight up lies.” “The main reason [OpenAI] accepted [the DOD’s deal] and we did not is that they cared about placating employees, and we actually cared about preventing abuses,” Amodei wrote in the memo. Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth has pledged to declare Anthropic a “ supply-chain risk ,” essentially blacklisting the company from working with any other company that has business with the U.S. military — although he has yet to take any legal action to that effect. This sort of designation is typically reserved for foreign adversaries, and it’s unclear whether it would survive a court challenge.
title: Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei could still be trying to make a deal with Pentagon
movement_title: Anthropic与美军合同破裂，重启谈判寻求妥协
movement_abstract: Anthropic与美国国防部（DOD）价值2亿美元的合同上周因双方在军方能否无限制访问其AI技术的问题上未能达成一致而破裂。当DOD转而与OpenAI达成协议后，外界认为Anthropic与军方的合作将结束。但据《金融时报》和《彭博社》报道，Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei已恢复与五角大楼官员Emil Michael的谈判，试图就合同条款达成妥协，以确保军方能继续使用其AI模型。Amodei曾因合同中允许军方用于“任何合法用途”的条款表示担忧，认为这可能被用于国内监控或自主武器。DOD随后与OpenAI达成协议，而Amodei则批评OpenAI的协议为“安全表演”，并称其宣传为“谎言”。国防部长Pete Hegseth已承诺将Anthropic列为“供应链风险”，但尚未采取法律行动。

content: A new report by Google found that about half of the zero-day bugs it tracked last year exploited enterprise devices, marking a new high for hackers who are increasingly finding new ways to target large companies and steal their data. According to the search and security giant’s annual report , 48% of the tracked zero-days — vulnerabilities in software that are unknown to its maker at the time they are exploited — were found in technologies used by corporations and large businesses. About half of those zero-days exploited the very devices that are designed to protect enterprise networks from digital intruders. Google said security and networking devices, such as firewalls made by Cisco and Fortinet , and VPN and virtualization platforms like Ivanti and VMware , were among the top targeted vendors last year. All four of the companies said hackers have exploited their products on customer networks in recent months. Google’s researchers said that hackers exploited common flaws, like input validation and incomplete authorization processes, to break through firewall and VPN defenses to gain access to customer networks. These classes of bugs are generally easier to exploit, but typically require a software update to fix. The company also pointed to other buggy software that makes up the remaining half of enterprise zero-days. Google noted the Clop extortion gang’s campaign against Oracle E-Business Suite customers, which allowed hackers to walk away with reams of human resources data from dozens of companies about their staff and executives. The hacks affected Harvard University , the American Airlines subsidiary Envoy , and The Washington Post , among others. The remaining 52% of zero-day bugs were found in consumer and end-user products, such as those made by Microsoft, Google, and Apple, according to the report. Most of the zero-days in consumer software were found in operating systems, with mobile devices also seeing more zero-days than in previous years. Google said it also attributed more zero-days to surveillance vendors than traditional government-backed espionage groups. Surveillance vendors are typically spyware makers and exploit developers, which work on behalf of governments to hack into people’s phones. Google said this shift demonstrated “a slow but sure movement in the landscape” in how governments seek access to hacking tools.
title: Google says half of all zero-days it tracked in 2025 targeted buggy enterprise tech

Follow Sidley Austin Follow Nippon Life Insurance Co Follow WASHINGTON, March 5 (Reuters) - ChatGPT maker OpenAI has been accused in a new lawsuit of practicing law without a U.S. license and helping a former disability claimant breach a settlement and flood a federal court docket with meritless filings. Nippon Life Insurance Company of America alleged on Wednesday in a lawsuit , opens new tab filed in federal court in Chicago that ‌OpenAI wrongfully provided legal assistance to a woman who sought to reopen a lawsuit that was already settled and dismissed. Sign up here. “ChatGPT is not an attorney,” the lawsuit said. Although OpenAI has shown ChatGPT can pass an attorney bar exam, Nippon said, “it has not been admitted to practice law in the State of Illinois or in any other jurisdiction within the United States.” The lawsuit seeks an order declaring that OpenAI violated Illinois' unauthorized practice of law statute, as well as $300,000 in compensatory damages ⁠and $10 million in punitive damages. OpenAI and a lawyer for Nippon, a subsidiary of the Japanese insurer Nissay [RIC:RIC:NPNLI.UL], did not immediately respond to requests for comment. Nippon claimed OpenAI encouraged the woman, an employee of a logistics company that had insurance coverage through Nippon, to press ahead in her already-settled disability case. Nippon said it spent significant time and resources and racked up substantial fees responding to the woman's ChatGPT-powered filings. The lawsuit appears to be one of the first cases to accuse a major AI developer of engaging in the unauthorized practice of law through a consumer‐facing chatbot. It comes as the technology's rapid adoption for legal filings has led to mounting AI “hallucinations” in court filings, leading judges to sanction litigants and lawyers for submitting filings with fabricated case citations or other unverified material ‌produced with ⁠generative AI tools. The case stems from filings by the employee after she settled her long‐term disability benefits suit with prejudice in January 2024, according to Nippon. The woman is not a defendant in the lawsuit. Nippon said the woman last year uploaded an email from her then-lawyer into ChatGPT, which allegedly validated her concerns about the advice she was being given. The woman fired her lawyer and moved to reopen her closed case using ⁠ChatGPT, the lawsuit said. A judge denied that bid in February 2025, but Nippon said the plaintiff then filed a new case and dozens of motions and notices that the company contends served “no legitimate legal or procedural purpose.” Nippon claims ChatGPT drafted those papers. Nippon said OpenAI amended its policies in ⁠October to bar users from using the platform for legal advice, but alleged it previously had no such prohibitions. The case is Nippon Life Insurance Company of America v. OpenAI Foundation and OpenAI Group PBC, U.S. District Court, Northern District of Illinois, No. 1:26-cv-02448. content: (中央社記者吳玟嶸金門5日電)金門縣警察局表示,金門114年成功攔阻詐騙金額3469萬餘元,較前1年成長近90%,成果歸功於警銀聯防通報機制成熟,並配合資通阻斷政策對涉詐貼文及帳號即時下架。 金門縣警察局今天透過新聞稿表示,民國114年度受理詐欺案共316件,較前1年減少80件,降幅20%;民眾財損金額約新台幣1億306萬元,較前1年減少5534萬元,降幅達35%。統計顯示,金門縣每10萬人口發生數與財損均遠低於全國平均。 警方指出,另對詐騙集團採「斷根溯源」偵查策略,114年間接連於金寧、金城等地偵破利用網路電話交換機(IP-PBX)及移動式節費設備(DMT)詐騙機房。此外,先後跨海赴台灣,在台北市查獲詐團成員等7人,並於高雄市誘捕面交車手,當場查扣117萬餘元。 除打詐外,警方表示,金門也落實預防端攔阻機制,114年成功攔阻47件詐騙,金額達3469萬餘元,較前1年成長率近90%,成果歸功於警銀聯防通報機制成熟,並配合資通阻斷政策,針對涉詐貼文及帳號即時下架,落實守護民眾財產。(編輯:張銘坤)1150305 本網站之文字、圖片及影音,非經授權,不得轉載、公開播送或公開傳輸及利用。

content: 網傳影片「美伊衝突,客機上拍到伊朗發射火箭反擊」? 挪用2024年日本火箭發射畫面 美國於2月28日對伊朗發動攻擊,伊朗也進行報復攻擊。網路流傳一段宣稱為「伊朗發射飛彈」反擊的空拍影片。經查,網傳影片實為2024年11月4日日本H3火箭4號機的發射畫面,由班機乘客在高空拍攝,與美伊衝突毫無關係。 一、網傳影像早在2024年11月4日即出現於社群平台,原始出處為X帳號「@shigex_」,拍攝者當時正搭班機,於高空捕捉到日本火箭升空過程。 二、影像原作者「@shigex_」也於2026年3月3日發文澄清,強調該影片遭未經授權盜用「這明明是日本商業火箭發射,根本不是什麼飛彈。」 傳言挪用無關影像,誤導為伊朗發射飛彈,這是「移花接木」的錯誤訊息。 背景 因應美、以、伊戰事,社群平台隨後流傳一段「一枚發光物體拖著長煙直衝雲霄」影片,宣稱是在從約旦出發的客機上拍到伊朗發射飛彈。 也有網路傳言明確指出:「一架民航客機拍攝的畫面顯示,一枚彈道飛彈從伊朗發射升空」。 查核 查核點:網傳影像來源 傳言影片實為2024年日本H3火箭發射畫面 針對網傳影片,查核記者透過反向圖搜追查發現,該影像早在2024年11月便已於instagram與Reddit等社群平台流傳,與近期美伊衝突毫無關聯。 進一步比對社群發文的關鍵字「日本H3火箭發射」,找到一個旅遊粉專於2024年11月4日發布的貼文,其內容與網傳畫面完全吻合。該粉專指出,影像來源為X帳號「@shigex_」,拍攝者當時正搭乘全日空(ANA)班機,從高空捕捉到JAXA(日本宇宙航空研究開發機構)從鹿兒島種子島宇宙中心發射H3火箭的壯觀瞬間。 經查證,「@shigex_」確實於2024年11月4日發布原始發文,並興奮寫下:「竟然在搭乘ANA時巧遇H3火箭4號機發射,真是太幸運了!直衝雲霄吧!(H3ロケット4号機の発射タイミングに、ANA搭乗中に幸運にも乗り合わせました!!天まで届けー!)」面對近期影片遭惡意挪用,原作者「@shigex_」也於2026年3月3日發文聲明:「這段影片是我在2024年11月上傳的原創內容,現在卻在未經授權的情況下被盜用轉載。這明明是日本商業火箭發射,根本不是什麼飛彈。」 根據《The Japan Times》報導,日本宇宙航空研究開發機構(JAXA)於2024年11月4日,在鹿兒島縣種子島宇宙中心成功發射了H3火箭4號機。該火箭搭載了防衛省的「煌3號」(Kirameki 3)X頻段衛星,該衛星具備高速、大容量且穩定的通訊能力,不易受天氣影響,主要用於支援自衛隊的作戰指令傳輸與海外部隊影像回傳。 報導指出,此次成功發射標誌著日本防衛通訊網的重要里程碑,完成防衛省規劃的3枚X頻段通訊衛星部署。這是H3火箭在2023年3月首飛失敗後,連續第3次成功發射,不僅增強了日本自主開發火箭的可靠性,也為未來爭取國際商業衛星發射訂單奠定了基礎。

movement_abstract: 网络流传一段声称是伊朗发射导弹反击的空拍影片，经核查实为2024年11月4日日本H3火箭4号机发射画面，由乘客在高空拍摄。原始影像来源为X账号「@shigex_」，于2024年11月4日发布，并于2026年3月3日澄清该影片被未经授权盗用，强调其为日本商业火箭发射，与伊朗冲突无关。该影片因近期美伊战事被误传为伊朗导弹发射，属错误信息。日本JAXA于2024年11月4日成功发射H3火箭4号机，搭载防衛省卫星，标志着日本防衛通訊網的重要进展。

content: (中央社記者洪學廣高雄5日電)刑事局破獲竹聯幫成員在台中架設多處詐騙機房,並假扮中國公安恐嚇香港民眾跟海外華人,半年就詐得數千萬元,警方循線逮捕張姓主嫌和幕後金主等15人,其中10人聲押獲准。 刑事局南部詐欺偵查中心偵辦詐欺案時,發現竹聯幫承信會25歲張姓男子與28歲林姓幫派份子等人在台中市豐原、太平、北屯等區架設詐騙機房,並假扮中國大陸公安大量發話給香港民眾及海外華人,以「涉犯重大刑案,未配合匯款監管財產,將會送至內地受審」等具威脅性說詞,恐嚇受話民眾。 警方查出,機房成員甚至身著公安制服開視訊以取信被害人,被害人在恐慌下只好配合匯款,殊不知在通訊設備彼端,受理報案的竟是假公安。 刑事警察局南部打擊犯罪中心今天表示,警方經報請台灣台中地方檢察署指揮偵辦,待蒐證完畢於去年11月、今年1月前往台中市豐原區、北屯區、太平區等處機房攻堅,當場逮捕張姓、林姓幫派成員與機房成員共13人,查扣手機32支、平板2台、筆電4台、現金新台幣14萬3200元、市價400多萬元賓士車、工作隔音箱等證物。 警方初步調查,機房成立約半年多,已詐騙多名華人得逞,初估不法獲利高達數千萬元。警方今年1月份溯源查緝金主與另一名機房幹部到案,全案將張嫌等15人依刑法詐欺、洗錢防制法、組織犯罪防制條例等罪送交台中地檢署偵辦。檢察官複訊後,向台中地方法院聲押其中10人獲准。(編輯:李亨山)1150305 本網站之文字、圖片及影音,非經授權,不得轉載、公開播送或公開傳輸及利用。

REUTERS/Dado Ruvic/Illustration/File Photo Purchase Licensing Rights , opens new tab JAKARTA, March 5 (Reuters) - Indonesia's communications ministry has issued a "stern warning" to Meta Platforms Inc (META.O) , opens new tab for failing to curb the spread of online ‌gambling and disinformation, the ministry said on Thursday. Sign up here. The warning came after Indonesia's Communications and Digital Affairs Minister Meutya Hafid on Wednesday made an unscheduled visit to Meta's operational office in ⁠Jakarta. Meta was warned over its low level of compliance with Indonesia's regulation regarding the spread of content that involved disinformation, online gambling, defamation and hate speech across its platforms, such as Facebook, Instagram, and WhatsApp, the ministry said. Meta did not immediately respond to a request for comment. Meta had ‌taken ⁠action over only 28.47% of flagged content related to online gambling and disinformation, the ministry said. "Disinformation, defamation, and hate content threaten lives in Indonesia, yet Meta ⁠has allowed them to persist," Meutya said. The ministry urged Meta to strengthen its content moderation systems and accelerate ⁠the removal of illegal and harmful material. The ministry had summoned representatives of Meta and other social media ⁠platforms last year and ordered them to boost content moderation due to the spread of disinformation. title: Indonesia gives Meta 'stern warning' over disinformation
movement_title: 印尼警告Meta未能有效遏制虚假信息和在线赌博传播
movement_abstract: 印尼通信与数字事务部长穆蒂亚·哈菲德于3月5日表示，印尼通信部已对Meta平台发出严厉警告，因其未能有效遏制在线赌博和虚假信息的传播。印尼通信部指出，Meta在处理涉及虚假信息、在线赌博、诽谤和仇恨言论的内容时，仅删除了28.47%的标记内容，远低于监管要求。部长强调，虚假信息、诽谤和仇恨内容对印尼社会构成威胁，并敦促Meta加强内容审核系统，加快删除非法和有害内容。此前，印尼已要求社交媒体平台加强内容管理以应对虚假信息的扩散。

content: (中央社華盛頓4日綜合外電報導)美國跨黨派國會議員今天提出國安疑慮,指英特爾(Intel)測試具有中國背景的盛美半導體公司(ACM Research)晶片製造設備,可能會讓英特爾的敏感資訊被洩漏給中國客戶。 總部位於美國加州的ACM Research,在那斯達克上市的股票代號為ACMR,這是一家生產晶片製造設備的公司,與中國有深厚淵源,旗下兩家海外子公司曾遭美國制裁。 民主黨籍聯邦參議員華倫(Elizabeth Warren)與共和黨籍議員柯頓(Tom Cotton)等人今天跨黨派連署致函。 議員們表示,盛美半導體的客戶包括一些受美國制裁的中國企業,如長江存儲(YMTC)、長鑫存儲(CXMT)與中芯國際(SMIC)等。 國會議員致函英特爾執行長陳立武(Lip-Bu Tan)指出:「ACM若能進入英特爾的設施,則有機會接觸到先進的晶片製造流程,因此可能藉此大幅提升ACM本身及中國軍工企業的技術品質與競爭力。」 英特爾聲明說:「ACM的設備並未用於英特爾的半導體生產流程」,強調英特爾完全遵守美國法規,並且已就安全事務與美國政府定期溝通。 針對美議員們的疑慮,ACM未立即回覆路透社的置評要求。(編譯:紀錦玲)1150305 本網站之文字、圖片及影音,非經授權,不得轉載、公開播送或公開傳輸及利用。

movement_title: 美议员质疑英特尔测试中国背景半导体设备涉国安风险
movement_abstract: 美国跨党派国会议员提出国安疑虑，指控英特尔测试具有中国背景的盛美半导体公司（ACM Research）的芯片制造设备，可能泄露敏感信息给中国客户。ACM Research总部位于美国加州，纳斯达克上市，与中国有深厚渊源，旗下两家子公司曾遭美国制裁。议员们指出，ACM的客户包括受制裁的中国公司，如长江存储、长鑫存储和中芯国际。议员致函英特尔CEO陈立武，质疑ACM进入英特尔设施可能提升其及中国军工企业的技术竞争力。英特尔回应称ACM设备未用于其生产流程，并强调遵守美国法规。ACM未立即回应置评要求。

content: (中央社記者曾筠庭台北5日電)經濟部國際貿易署今天公告指出,為強化打擊詐欺犯罪,將自8日起新增網路電話交換機(IP-PBX)及網路電話閘道器(VoIP Gateway)專屬貨品號列,並增列輸入規定,未來進口相關設備須檢附國家通訊傳播委員會(NCC)審驗證明或進口核准文件,以利從源頭管理及追蹤流向,降低設備遭濫用為詐騙工具的風險。 經濟部指出,相關設備因成本及維護複雜度較高,多為企業商業用途,較少用於一般家庭,透過新增貨品號列與輸入規定,可強化進口管理與流向追蹤,降低設備遭不法利用的風險。 經濟部說明,近年詐騙集團常利用網路電話交換機與網路電話閘道器進行詐騙,相關設備可透過網路技術偽裝來電來源,甚至大量自動撥打電話,增加執法機關追查難度。電信設備主管機關NCC為此函請貿易署新增專屬貨品號列並訂定輸入規定,以利進行源頭管制。 經濟部指出,此次修正將原本包含網路電話交換機及網路電話閘道器在內多種設備儀器的貨品號列刪除,分為2個新增貨品號列,其一為「網路電話交換機、網路電話閘道器」等電信終端設備,輸入規定為「643」,進口時須憑NCC或其委託驗證機構核發的審驗證明辦理通關;若為審驗、研發、測試、展示、加工、維修或組裝後再出口等用途,則須取得NCC核發的進口證明文件。 另一項新增貨品號列為「其他接收、轉換及傳輸或再生聲音、圖像或其他資料之機器,包括交換器及路由器」,輸入規定為「C02」,部分商品須依經濟部標準檢驗局規定辦理進口檢驗。 經濟部表示,網路電話交換機是一種以網際網路技術運作的通訊伺服器,可透過網路管理企業內部分機並撥打電話,企業僅需透過網路即可整合通訊系統並降低通話成本。不過這項設備也可能被詐騙集團利用,例如架設於境外並透過網路連回台灣電信網路,偽裝為國內市話撥出,或利用自動撥號功能大量發送詐騙電話。 此外,網路電話閘道器則可將傳統類比電話訊號與網路數位封包互相轉換,使企業既有電話設備可接入網路系統並整合多條電話線,然而該設備也可能被用來將網路訊號轉換為行動電話訊號,串接大量SIM卡,形成訊號落地斷點,增加追查發話來源的困難。(編輯:林淑媛)1150305 本網站之文字、圖片及影音,非經授權,不得轉載、公開播送或公開傳輸及利用。

movement_title: 经济部新增网络电话设备专属货品号列强化源头管理
movement_abstract: 经济部国际贸易署宣布自8日起新增网络电话交换机（IP-PBX）及网络电话网关（VoIP Gateway）专属货品号列，并增列输入规定。未来进口相关设备需检附国家通讯传播委员会（NCC）审验证明或进口核准文件，以强化源头管理及追踪流向，降低设备被滥用于诈骗工具的风险。经济部指出，此类设备多用于企业商业用途，近年诈骗集团常利用其进行诈骗，设备可伪装来电来源并大量自动拨打电话，增加执法机关追查难度。NCC函请贸易署新增专属货品号列并订定输入规定，以利源头管制。此次修正将原包含多种设备的货品号列删除，分为两个新增货品号列，分别对应不同输入规定。

content: 警政署刑事警察局預防科科長莊明雄分享:「在高科技發達的AI與視訊時代裡,詐騙早已超越聰明與否。真正的關鍵,是你是否願意停下來多一次查證。」 文/編輯部 近年台灣詐騙樣態快速轉型,從早期單一話術的電話詐騙,演變為結合社群平台、影音視訊與AI技術的產業化操作。當前財損金額最高的類型為假投資詐騙,詐騙集團已不再依賴單一網站,而是透過假App、即時通訊與分工細緻的詐騙節點,形成更難追查的犯罪鏈。 隨著節慶與消費旺季來臨,假網拍與物流詐騙也同步升溫,展現高度季節化的詐騙趨勢。更值得注意的是,視訊假檢警與深偽影像逐漸出現,使受害者在「看得見的人」面前放下戒心。 警政署刑事警察局預防科警務正張佳勳指出,詐騙已不僅僅是傳統治安問題,更是科技、心理與金融交錯的社會挑戰,唯有制度、教育與數位素養同步提升,才能降低受害機率。 在近年的詐騙案件中,高學歷與專業背景已不再是防護罩,反而成為詐騙集團精準鎖定的目標。許多詐騙受害者並非資訊不足,而是過度相信自身判斷,而忽略基本查證流程。假投資平台往往以精緻介面、即時獲利數據塑造「專業感」。為博得信任,詐騙集團在初期甚至刻意安排小額出金成功,營造資金可自由提領的假象,誘使受害者持續加碼;待投入金額提高後,再以系統維修、帳戶異常或需補繳手續費等理由限制出金,藉拖延手法層層設障。 詐騙者更透過長時間聊天蒐集個人背景,精準抓住受害者對財務規劃、退休準備或職涯發展的焦慮與期待,進行心理操作。高智識不是免疫力,反而可能成為弱點──越想證明自己判斷正確,就越不願意停損與查證。當人越相信自己看得懂風險,越容易忽略最簡單的警訊,也讓「自信」成為判斷力最大的盲點。 面對詐騙型態持續升級,政府近年將防制重心前移,逐步建立「事前預防、跨部會合作、科技防詐」三大策略。刑事局指出,阻詐機制已嵌入金融流程,如轉帳前顯示戶名與風險提醒,讓民眾在資金流出前多一道檢核;同時結合金管會、銀行與數位平台,建立通報與即時下架機制,縮短詐騙網站與可疑帳戶的存活時間。 面對生成式AI崛起,警方與金融機構也導入AI模型分析異常交易行為,提前鎖定高風險金流,並透過宣導與案例分享提升社會識詐能力,讓防詐從制度設計延伸至日常行為,逐步形成全民共同參與的安全防線。 隨著生成式AI與深偽技術快速普及,詐騙手法同步升級,警方偵防思維也從「辨識話術」轉向「辨識影像與行為」。在預警機制上,持續蒐集案件數據,並與金融機構合作建立AI風險模型,同時強化影像鑑識與數位追蹤能力,從光影細節、畫面異常與語音特徵中尋找破綻。 然而,受害者往往難以在第一時間辨識深偽影像,使資料庫標記與分析仍存在盲區。面對科技與犯罪的拉鋸戰,警方除提升設備與跨域合作,也回歸宣導本質,教導民眾透過可疑細節與程序查證建立第一道防線。 面對詐騙手法日益翻新,張佳勳提醒,新的一年關鍵不在學會複雜辨識技巧,而是養成「先查證、再行動」的習慣。對民眾而言,只要涉及金流、個資或要求下載陌生App的訊息,都應先停下腳步確認來源,避免因急迫或信任感而貿然操作;對企業來說,則應把防詐納入風險管理,建立內部通報與雙重驗證機制,避免單一窗口即可完成轉帳或資料變更。 張佳勳更指出,要求監管帳戶、出金前再匯款,或以客服、投資老師名義私下聯繫者,都是常見危險訊號,若遇可疑為詐騙情形,可撥打165反詐騙專線諮詢。日前警政署於「165打詐儀錶板」導入AI智能客服小幫手,整合防詐資料庫提供即時互動諮詢,可依所描述情境,辨識詐騙風險並提供具體處置建議;另具備涉詐網址即時查詢功能,可判斷網站是否具詐騙風險。唯有把防詐意識融入日常決策,才能在數位時代守住安全防線。 *看單篇不過癮?《全球中央》紙本雜誌、電子雜誌全面特價中。 *訂閱紙本雜誌《 》 *實體雜誌銷售:誠品書店 *電子雜誌銷售平台: 、 、 、 、 、 、 、 、 、 、 、 、 、 等 本網站之文字、圖片及影音,非經授權,不得轉載、公開播送或公開傳輸及利用。
